challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: The slower, shorter replies and absence of follow-up questions provide meaningful evidence of withdrawal, but they are also compatible with Sam's stated low bandwidth.
Canceling two one-on-one meetings without concrete replacements strengthens B, although the cancellations occurred during the documented period of broader reduced participation.

Group attendance and online posting while Riley's messages remained unanswered suggest selective availability, but two brief gatherings and several posts do not establish that Sam had comparable capacity for direct interaction.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: A remains better supported because C3-F1 identifies substantial situational pressures immediately before the change, C3-F2 shows reduced participation beyond Riley, and C3-F3 explicitly describes unusually low bandwidth and an intention to reconnect after the deadline. C3-F4 through C3-F6 materially support B and lower confidence, but do not outweigh that combined evidence.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Allow the stated low-bandwidth period to pass and then assess whether Sam reconnects or resumes prior engagement; if not, direct clarification would be appropriate.
